title: God of War fans just got bad news #godofwar #shorts
description: God of War Laufey has been delayed until May 2027. Source: TheSixthAxis.

scenes.say: Bad news for God of War fans.
God of War Laufey has been delayed until May twenty twenty seven.
So that's a lot more waiting for Kratos fans.
Delays usually mean more polish, just like GTA 6.
Would you rather wait for a better game, or play it sooner?
